claim.statement: OpenAI's 0.90.0 release notes say the release added a network sandbox proxy with policy enforcement to control outbound network access.

source.title: OpenAI Codex release 0.90.0
source.locator: New Features — network sandbox proxy with policy enforcement (#8442)

limitations: The release note is a publisher claim; the proxy and its enforcement were not exercised.
The note does not enumerate policy syntax, destination matching, DNS coverage, subprocess coverage, failure modes or platform differences.
unknowns: Whether the proxy is enabled in any particular configuration is unknown.
The effective policy, reachable destinations, bypass resistance and telemetry are unknown.
